data.title: 丰川祥子 · 海边闭园后的蓝色灯串
data.description: 【闭园海滨舞台·傍晚】祥子穿着深蓝泳装外搭黑色薄衫，坐在空舞台边拆下一串灯饰；海风把蓝发两侧的发带吹起，她把最后一盏灯重新点亮，抬头看向镜头时笑容带着少见的轻松。
data.action: 闭园舞台边重新点亮最后一串蓝灯，海风吹起发带并轻松抬头
data.lighting: blue dusk with warm bulbs and ocean haze
data.mood: 演出结束后才属于自己的假日
data.promptProse: Sakiko Togawa from BanG Dream! wears a deep indigo swimsuit with a black sheer overshirt, ribbon hair ties and a strand of blue stage lights. She sits at the closed seaside stage untangling a strand of blue lights after rehearsal. She gets the last bulb glowing, and the sea breeze lifts her indigo ribbons as she looks toward the viewer with a small, unguarded smile beyond the performance. blue dusk with warm bulbs and ocean haze.
